label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The first Tab presses landed on several unnamed div elements with no label, and pressing Enter on one did nothing, so I could not tell where I was.
The rotating promo banner trapped Tab: focus kept jumping between two banner links and never moved on to the menu or products. Only the Skip to main content link got me out.
After the skip link, focus went to a Shop Now link and then to list items for the category tabs with no sign they were interactive. The main menu and the cart link were never reached by Tab.

Each product card needs 4 to 5 Tab presses to get to its Add to Cart button, because of repeated links and a subscription toggle. The toggle is switched on by default, and its name only says Disable, so the state was unclear.

element.name: Disable subscription and save option for Bar Soap 6-Pack

findings.problem: After adding to cart, the drawer opened with only a loading Calculating message and focus stayed on a generic div. I needed 8 more Tab presses through quantity and remove buttons to reach Checkout.
The checkout page was blank right after I pressed Checkout, with nothing focused and no announcement that it was loading. I had to read the page again to see the form.
